categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and modifies `src/wallet/legacybdb.cpp`, directly affecting the legacy BDB migration path.
categories.rationale: Prevents infinite loops and severe memory inflation when parsing crafted BDB files during wallet migration. The author notes that 'On master an ~8 KB file built this way doesn't finish' and 'a 256 KB file took migratewallet from 54 MB to ~800 MB', which reviewers confirmed hangs on master and is fixed here.
